statement: file_id=SRC-01;file_class=SOURCE;authority_level=2;governed_by=GOV-00;status=ACTIVE
violation: SRC-01 lacks the canonical FILE-META record or uses a non-ACTIVE status without higher-authority direction.
verification: Verify the first SRC-01 metadata record exactly matches the canonical metadata statement.

statement: SRC-01 owns canister authority model, trusted Gateway envelope, cross-canister correctness boundaries, caller identity model, authority rules, and bootstrap authority separation.
violation: A generated source record routes SRC-01-owned canister authority behavior to a file other than SRC-01.
verification: Check canister authority records against SRC-INDEX responsibility routing.

statement: SRC-01 owns ARCH-* record ids.
violation: A generated source record defines ARCH-* semantics outside SRC-01.
verification: Validate ARCH-* record ownership against SRC-INDEX namespace routing.

statement: SRC-01 is a SOURCE class governed file.
violation: SRC-01 is generated with any class other than SOURCE.
verification: Validate the class field of every SRC-01 record equals SOURCE.

statement: SRC-01 has authority_level 2.
violation: SRC-01 is generated with any authority_level other than 2.
verification: Validate the authority_level field of every SRC-01 record equals 2.

statement: SRC-01 owns AUTH-* record ids.
violation: A generated source record defines AUTH-* semantics outside SRC-01.
verification: Validate AUTH-* record ownership against SRC-INDEX namespace routing.

statement: SRC-01 owns AUTH-CALLER-* record ids.
violation: A generated source record defines AUTH-CALLER-* semantics outside SRC-01.
verification: Validate AUTH-CALLER-* record ownership against SRC-INDEX namespace routing.

statement: SRC-01 owns BOOT-* record ids.
violation: A generated source record defines BOOT-* semantics outside SRC-01.
verification: Validate BOOT-* record ownership against SRC-INDEX namespace routing.

statement: SRC-01 must not define source truth owned by SRC-00 or SRC-02 through SRC-10.
violation: A SRC-01 record defines source truth routed to another SRC file by SRC-INDEX.
verification: Compare each SRC-01 statement against SRC-INDEX responsibility and namespace maps.

statement: The MVP canister layout includes Frontend/User, Gateway Canister, Ledger Core Canister, and Read Model Canister.
violation: The MVP canister layout omits one of Frontend/User, Gateway Canister, Ledger Core Canister, or Read Model Canister, or adds another required authoritative write canister.
verification: Review architecture records and generated diagrams for the declared MVP canister layout.

statement: External users enter the MVP write path through Gateway Canister.
violation: An MVP write path allows external users to bypass Gateway Canister without explicit direct-call authority.
verification: Review write-path routing claims for Gateway entry before Ledger Core execution.

statement: Gateway Canister calls Ledger Core Canister for authoritative execution.
violation: Gateway Canister is treated as the authoritative executor of balance-affecting operations.
verification: Review canister authority claims for Gateway-to-Ledger-Core execution routing.

statement: Read Model Canister derives views from Ledger Core state, journal, or checkpoints.
violation: Read Model Canister is treated as deriving authoritative write truth from a source other than Ledger Core state, journal, or checkpoints.
verification: Review Read Model boundary statements for derivation from Ledger Core source data only.

statement: Ledger Core is the only canister allowed to make balance-affecting commit decisions.
violation: A canister other than Ledger Core is allowed to make final balance-affecting commit decisions.
verification: Review canister authority matrix for final balance-affecting commit authority assigned only to Ledger Core.

statement: Gateway is non-authoritative for balance-affecting correctness.
violation: Gateway is treated as final authority for balance-affecting correctness.
verification: Review Gateway boundary claims for non-authoritative balance-affecting correctness status.

statement: Read Model is non-authoritative for balance-affecting correctness.
violation: Read Model is treated as final authority for balance-affecting correctness.
verification: Review Read Model boundary claims for non-authoritative balance-affecting correctness status.

statement: Gateway may accept external requests.
violation: Gateway external request acceptance is treated as forbidden without higher-authority source change.
verification: Review request-entry routing for Gateway acceptance of external requests.

statement: Gateway may authenticate external caller identity.
violation: Gateway external caller authentication is treated as forbidden without higher-authority source change.
verification: Review caller-identity routing for Gateway external caller authentication.

statement: Gateway may validate request shape.
violation: Gateway request-shape validation is treated as forbidden without higher-authority source change.
verification: Review Gateway boundary claims for non-authoritative request-shape validation only.

statement: Gateway may normalize request fields.
violation: Gateway request-field normalization is treated as forbidden without higher-authority source change.
verification: Review Gateway boundary claims for request normalization before Ledger Core execution.

statement: Gateway may create an authenticated request envelope.
violation: Gateway authenticated envelope creation is treated as forbidden without higher-authority source change.
verification: Review Gateway boundary claims for authenticated request envelope construction.

statement: Gateway must not be the final debit authority.
violation: Gateway is treated as the final debit authority for balance-affecting operations.
verification: Review debit-authorization claims for Ledger Core final authority.

statement: Gateway must not perform final sufficient-funds authority.
violation: Gateway is treated as final authority for sufficient-funds decisions.
verification: Review authority-boundary claims for sufficient-funds authority assigned to Ledger Core only.

statement: Gateway must not mutate authoritative balances.
violation: Gateway mutates or is allowed to mutate authoritative balances.
verification: Review canister authority matrix for Gateway balance mutation authority.

statement: Gateway must not append authoritative ledger entries.
violation: Gateway appends or is allowed to append authoritative ledger entries.
verification: Review canister authority matrix for Gateway ledger-entry append authority.

statement: Gateway must not store authoritative operation results.
violation: Gateway stores or is allowed to store authoritative operation results.
verification: Review canister authority matrix for authoritative operation-result storage.

statement: Gateway must construct trusted envelope fields from ICP execution context and normalized request data.
violation: Gateway constructs trusted envelope fields from any source other than ICP execution context and normalized request data.
verification: Review envelope-construction claims for ICP execution context plus normalized request data.

statement: Gateway must not copy trusted identity fields from arbitrary user request body.
violation: Gateway copies callerPrincipal, originalCallerPrincipal, debitAuthorityPrincipal, or equivalent trusted identity fields from arbitrary user request body into authority-bearing envelope fields.
verification: Review trusted identity field sources for exclusion of arbitrary user request body fields.

statement: Ledger Core verifies Gateway envelope validity.
violation: Ledger Core accepts Gateway-mediated execution without verifying Gateway envelope validity.
verification: Review Ledger Core authority boundary for Gateway envelope validation.

statement: Ledger Core verifies Gateway canister authorization.
violation: Ledger Core accepts Gateway-mediated execution without verifying Gateway canister authorization.
verification: Review Ledger Core authority boundary for authorized Gateway canister verification.

statement: Ledger Core verifies debit authority.
violation: Ledger Core commits a balance-affecting operation without debit authority verification.
verification: Review Ledger Core authority boundary for debit authority verification before commit.

statement: Ledger Core decides whether a request is financially valid and commit-safe.
violation: A canister other than Ledger Core is treated as final authority for financial validity or commit safety.
verification: Review authority-boundary records for financial validity and commit safety owner.

statement: Ledger Core authorizes balance-affecting operations.
violation: A canister other than Ledger Core is treated as final authorization authority for balance-affecting operations.
verification: Review authority-boundary records for balance-affecting authorization owner.

statement: Ledger Core commits balance-affecting operations.
violation: A canister other than Ledger Core is treated as final commit authority for balance-affecting operations.
verification: Review authority-boundary records for balance-affecting commit owner.

statement: Ledger Core may validate request shape independently.
violation: Ledger Core independent request-shape validation is treated as forbidden without higher-authority source change.
verification: Review Ledger Core boundary claims for independent request-shape validation.

statement: Ledger Core may normalize request fields independently.
violation: Ledger Core independent request normalization is treated as forbidden without higher-authority source change.
verification: Review Ledger Core boundary claims for independent request-field normalization.

statement: Ledger Core reads immediateCallerPrincipal from ICP execution context.
violation: Ledger Core uses an untrusted request body field or non-execution-context source as immediateCallerPrincipal.
verification: Review caller identity model for immediateCallerPrincipal source.

statement: Ledger Core must not accept debitAuthorityPrincipal from arbitrary user request body.
violation: Ledger Core treats debitAuthorityPrincipal from arbitrary user request body as an authority source.
verification: Review caller identity model for debitAuthorityPrincipal source exclusion from arbitrary user body.

statement: Ledger Core must use debitAuthorityPrincipal, not Gateway immediateCallerPrincipal, when checking source-account ownership.
violation: Ledger Core checks source-account ownership against Gateway immediateCallerPrincipal in Gateway-mediated execution.
verification: Review authorization logic claims for debitAuthorityPrincipal use in source-account ownership checks.

statement: Ledger Core must reject Gateway-envelope execution from an unauthorized immediate caller.
violation: Ledger Core accepts Gateway-envelope execution when immediateCallerPrincipal is not an authorized Gateway Canister.
verification: Review Gateway-envelope trust rules for immediateCallerPrincipal authorization.

statement: Read Model may serve optimized derived views.
violation: Read Model optimized derived views are treated as forbidden without higher-authority source change.
verification: Review Read Model boundary claims for optimized derived view serving only.

statement: Read Model may rebuild projections from Ledger Core source data.
violation: Read Model projection rebuild from Ledger Core source data is treated as forbidden without higher-authority source change.
verification: Review Read Model boundary claims for rebuild from Ledger Core source data only.

statement: Read Model must not accept external balance-affecting requests.
violation: Read Model accepts an external balance-affecting request.
verification: Review Read Model authority boundary for absence of balance-affecting request entry.

statement: Read Model must not authenticate balance-affecting operations.
violation: Read Model authenticates a balance-affecting operation as part of write authority.
verification: Review Read Model authority boundary for absence of balance-affecting authentication authority.

statement: Read Model must not authorize balance-affecting operations.
violation: Read Model authorizes, approves, or rejects a balance-affecting operation.
verification: Review Read Model authority boundary for absence of balance-affecting authorization authority.

statement: Read Model must not mutate authoritative Ledger Core state.
violation: Read Model mutates authoritative Ledger Core state.
verification: Review Read Model boundary for absence of authoritative Ledger Core state mutation.

statement: Read Model must not affect balance-affecting correctness.
violation: Read Model state, freshness, sync, rebuild, or failure becomes required for balance-affecting correctness.
verification: Review authority boundary for Read Model exclusion from balance-affecting correctness.

statement: Detailed Read Model derivation, sync, freshness, and rebuild semantics belong to SRC-07.
violation: SRC-01 defines detailed Read Model derivation, sync, freshness, or rebuild semantics.
verification: Review SRC-01 records for detailed Read Model derivation semantics.

statement: originalCallerPrincipal means the external user principal authenticated by Gateway.
violation: originalCallerPrincipal is defined as any principal other than the external user principal authenticated by Gateway.
verification: Review caller identity records for originalCallerPrincipal definition consistency.

statement: immediateCallerPrincipal means the principal returned by ICP execution context in the currently executing canister method.
violation: immediateCallerPrincipal is defined as any principal not returned by ICP execution context in the currently executing canister method.
verification: Review caller identity records for immediateCallerPrincipal definition consistency.

statement: debitAuthorityPrincipal means the principal Ledger Core uses for Transfer debit authorization.
violation: debitAuthorityPrincipal is defined as a principal not used by Ledger Core for Transfer debit authorization.
verification: Review caller identity records for debitAuthorityPrincipal definition consistency.

statement: In Gateway-mediated execution, Gateway reads the external caller from ICP execution context.
violation: Gateway-mediated execution obtains external caller identity from arbitrary user request body or another untrusted source.
verification: Review Gateway-mediated caller flow for external caller source from ICP execution context.

statement: In Gateway-mediated execution, Gateway constructs a normalized authenticated request envelope.
violation: Gateway-mediated execution proceeds without Gateway constructing a normalized authenticated request envelope.
verification: Review Gateway-mediated write flow for normalized authenticated request envelope construction.

statement: In Gateway-mediated execution, Ledger Core sees Gateway as immediateCallerPrincipal.
violation: Gateway-mediated execution treats immediateCallerPrincipal as the original external user at Ledger Core.
verification: Review Gateway-mediated Ledger Core caller model for Gateway as immediateCallerPrincipal.

statement: In Gateway-mediated execution, Ledger Core verifies Gateway authorization before trusting originalCallerPrincipal.
violation: Ledger Core trusts originalCallerPrincipal before verifying Gateway authorization.
verification: Review Gateway-mediated Ledger Core caller model for Gateway authorization before originalCallerPrincipal use.

statement: In Gateway-mediated execution, debitAuthorityPrincipal equals originalCallerPrincipal after Gateway authorization is verified.
violation: Gateway-mediated execution sets debitAuthorityPrincipal to a principal other than verified originalCallerPrincipal.
verification: Review Gateway-mediated caller model for debitAuthorityPrincipal equality to verified originalCallerPrincipal.

statement: In Gateway-mediated execution, debitAuthorityPrincipal must not equal immediateCallerPrincipal unless Gateway itself is the source account owner.
violation: Gateway-mediated execution uses Gateway immediateCallerPrincipal as debitAuthorityPrincipal when Gateway is not the source account owner.
verification: Review Gateway-mediated caller model for separation of debitAuthorityPrincipal from immediateCallerPrincipal except Gateway-owned source-account cases.

statement: Generated implementations must not check source account ownership against the Gateway Canister principal instead of the authenticated external user principal.
violation: Generated implementation checks source account ownership against Gateway Canister principal instead of authenticated external user principal.
verification: Review generated implementation or design packet for source account ownership checks against authenticated external user principal.

statement: Gateway decides whether a request is well-formed and allowed to enter the system.
violation: A component other than Gateway is treated as the external request-entry decision point without explicit source authority.
verification: Review request-entry authority records for Gateway well-formedness and entry decision.

statement: Ledger Core decides whether the request is financially valid and commit-safe.
violation: A component other than Ledger Core is treated as final authority for financial validity or commit safety.
verification: Review authority-boundary records for Ledger Core financial-validity and commit-safety authority.

statement: Only Ledger Core may authorize and commit balance-affecting operations.
violation: A component other than Ledger Core is allowed to authorize or commit balance-affecting operations.
verification: Review authority-boundary records for exclusive Ledger Core authorization and commit authority.

statement: Ledger Core must independently verify debit authorization before commit.
violation: Ledger Core commits a balance-affecting operation without independently verifying debit authorization.
verification: Review Ledger Core authority boundary for independent debit authorization before commit.

statement: For Transfer, debitAuthorityPrincipal must equal the source account owner principal as referenced from SRC-02 and SRC-03 ownership.
violation: Transfer debit authorization permits debitAuthorityPrincipal to differ from the source account owner principal without later active source authority.
verification: Review Transfer debit authorization references for routing to SRC-02 account owner semantics and SRC-03 Transfer validation semantics.

statement: Read Model must not make authorization decisions for balance-affecting operations.
violation: Read Model authorizes, rejects, approves, or controls balance-affecting operations.
verification: Review Read Model authority boundary for absence of balance-affecting authorization authority.

statement: Admin/bootstrap authority must be explicitly separated from user transfer authority.
violation: Admin/bootstrap authority and user transfer authority are merged or ambiguous.
verification: Review authority model for explicit separation between bootstrap/admin authority and user Transfer authority.

statement: Direct Ledger Core calls may be allowed only if SRC-01 explicitly defines direct-call authorization semantics.
violation: Direct Ledger Core calls are allowed without explicit SRC-01 direct-call authorization semantics.
verification: Review direct Ledger Core write path claims for explicit SRC-01 authorization semantics.

statement: If direct Ledger Core authorization semantics are absent, Gateway-envelope execution is the MVP write-path model.
violation: A direct Ledger Core write path is used as the MVP write-path model without explicit direct-call authorization semantics.
verification: Review MVP write-path claims for Gateway-envelope execution when direct-call semantics are absent.

statement: Ledger Core may trust originalCallerPrincipal only through a Gateway-authenticated envelope.
violation: Ledger Core trusts originalCallerPrincipal outside a Gateway-authenticated envelope.
verification: Review originalCallerPrincipal trust paths for Gateway-authenticated envelope requirement.

statement: Ledger Core must verify immediateCallerPrincipal is an authorized Gateway Canister before using Gateway-attested originalCallerPrincipal.
violation: Ledger Core uses Gateway-attested originalCallerPrincipal before verifying immediateCallerPrincipal is an authorized Gateway Canister.
verification: Review Gateway envelope trust model for authorized immediateCallerPrincipal verification before originalCallerPrincipal use.

statement: Ledger Core must reject Gateway-envelope execution if immediateCallerPrincipal is not an authorized Gateway Canister.
violation: Ledger Core accepts Gateway-envelope execution from an unauthorized immediateCallerPrincipal.
verification: Review Gateway envelope execution path for rejection of unauthorized immediateCallerPrincipal.

statement: Gateway-authenticated envelope fields must be constructed by Gateway from ICP execution context and normalized request data.
violation: Gateway-authenticated envelope fields are constructed from arbitrary user body fields or unnormalized request data.
verification: Review envelope field construction for ICP execution context plus normalized request data sources.

statement: Gateway-authenticated envelope fields must not be copied from arbitrary user body fields.
violation: Gateway-authenticated envelope fields are copied from arbitrary user body fields.
verification: Review envelope field construction for exclusion of arbitrary user body fields.

statement: Trusted caller identity fields in a user request body are not authority sources.
violation: callerPrincipal, originalCallerPrincipal, debitAuthorityPrincipal, or equivalent user body fields are treated as trusted authority sources.
verification: Review request authority source claims for exclusion of trusted caller identity fields from user body.

statement: Cross-canister calls are authority-boundary crossings.
violation: A cross-canister call is treated as an intra-boundary local authority transfer without explicit source authority.
verification: Review architecture records for cross-canister calls classified as authority-boundary crossings.

statement: Cross-canister boundaries must not transfer final balance-affecting authority away from Ledger Core.
violation: A cross-canister boundary transfers final balance-affecting authority from Ledger Core to another canister.
verification: Review cross-canister authority records for Ledger Core retaining final balance-affecting authority.

statement: Gateway-to-Ledger-Core execution may cross a canister boundary before authoritative commit begins.
violation: Gateway-to-Ledger-Core execution before authoritative commit is treated as forbidden without higher-authority source change.
verification: Review write path for Gateway-to-Ledger-Core boundary occurring before authoritative commit begins.

statement: Authoritative balance mutation and journal proof must remain under Ledger Core authority as constrained by SRC-00 ADR and SRC-05 ownership.
violation: Authoritative balance mutation or journal proof is moved outside Ledger Core authority.
verification: Review authority records for Ledger Core ownership of authoritative balance mutation and journal proof with detailed journal semantics routed to SRC-05.

statement: Read Model update failure must not become a condition for Ledger Core write correctness as referenced to SRC-07 and SRC-05 ownership.
violation: Ledger Core write correctness depends on Read Model update success.
verification: Review authority records for Read Model update failure exclusion from Ledger Core write correctness.

statement: No separate canister may become required for authoritative balance or journal commit in MVP as referenced to SRC-00 and SRC-05 ownership.
violation: MVP authoritative balance or journal commit requires a separate canister.
verification: Review architecture and ADR records for absence of separate canister requirement for authoritative balance or journal commit.

statement: MVP may use deterministic seed/bootstrap state for demo accounts, demo asset, and initial balances.
violation: Deterministic demo bootstrap state is treated as forbidden without higher-authority source change.
verification: Review bootstrap authority records for deterministic demo seed state allowance.

statement: Bootstrap logic must be separated from runtime Transfer execution.
violation: Bootstrap logic is reachable through runtime Transfer execution.
verification: Review bootstrap authority boundary for separation from runtime Transfer execution.

statement: Bootstrap logic must not be callable as a normal user balance-affecting operation.
violation: Bootstrap logic is callable as a normal user balance-affecting operation.
verification: Review bootstrap authority boundary for absence of normal user balance-affecting operation exposure.

statement: Asset creation is not part of MVP runtime behavior unless explicitly added later by active source authority.
violation: Asset creation is exposed as MVP runtime behavior without later active source authority.
verification: Review MVP runtime behavior for asset creation exposure and active source authority.

statement: Account creation is not part of MVP runtime behavior unless explicitly added later by active source authority.
violation: Account creation is exposed as MVP runtime behavior without later active source authority.
verification: Review MVP runtime behavior for account creation exposure and active source authority.

statement: Initial demo balances must be traceable as bootstrap state, not Transfer-created state.
violation: Initial demo balances are represented as Transfer-created state.
verification: Review demo state records for bootstrap-state traceability instead of Transfer-created state.

statement: Bootstrap state must not weaken Transfer invariants.
violation: Bootstrap state creates a runtime bypass or exception that weakens Transfer invariants.
verification: Review bootstrap boundary records for no runtime Transfer invariant bypass.

statement: No public setBalance, mintBalance, or overwriteBalance API may exist in MVP.
violation: A public setBalance, mintBalance, or overwriteBalance API exists in MVP.
verification: Review MVP API surface for absence of public setBalance, mintBalance, and overwriteBalance APIs.

statement: Admin-only functions, if present, must be clearly separated from user operation APIs.
violation: Admin-only functions are exposed through or conflated with user operation APIs.
verification: Review authority model for explicit separation between admin-only functions and user operation APIs.

statement: SRC-01 must not define project identity semantics.
violation: A SRC-01 record defines project identity semantics instead of referencing SRC-00.
verification: Review SRC-01 records for project identity definitions.

statement: SRC-01 must not define domain entity semantics.
violation: A SRC-01 record defines domain entity semantics instead of referencing SRC-02.
verification: Review SRC-01 records for domain entity definitions.

statement: SRC-01 must not define detailed Transfer validation, lifecycle, or result semantics.
violation: A SRC-01 record defines detailed Transfer validation, lifecycle, or result semantics instead of referencing SRC-03.
verification: Review SRC-01 records for detailed Transfer validation, lifecycle, or result definitions.

statement: SRC-01 must not define idempotency or replay semantics.
violation: A SRC-01 record defines idempotency or replay semantics instead of referencing SRC-04.
verification: Review SRC-01 records for idempotency or replay definitions.

statement: SRC-01 must not define ledger, journal, invariant, timestamp, commit, or atomicity semantics.
violation: A SRC-01 record defines ledger, journal, invariant, timestamp, commit, or atomicity semantics instead of referencing SRC-05.
verification: Review SRC-01 records for ledger, journal, invariant, timestamp, commit, or atomicity definitions.

statement: SRC-01 must not define failure-class semantics.
violation: A SRC-01 record defines failure-class semantics instead of referencing SRC-06.
verification: Review SRC-01 records for failure-class definitions.

statement: SRC-01 must not define detailed Read Model derivation semantics.
violation: A SRC-01 record defines detailed Read Model derivation, sync, freshness, or rebuild semantics instead of referencing SRC-07.
verification: Review SRC-01 records for detailed Read Model derivation definitions.

statement: SRC-01 must not define upgrade or stable-state semantics.
violation: A SRC-01 record defines upgrade or stable-state semantics instead of referencing SRC-08.
verification: Review SRC-01 records for upgrade or stable-state definitions.

statement: SRC-01 must not define API or forbidden behavior records.
violation: A SRC-01 record defines API or forbidden behavior records instead of referencing SRC-09.
verification: Review SRC-01 records for API or forbidden behavior definitions.

statement: SRC-01 must not define test-proof, DONE, risk, or falsifier semantics.
violation: A SRC-01 record defines test-proof, DONE, risk, or falsifier semantics instead of referencing SRC-10.
verification: Review SRC-01 records for test-proof, DONE, risk, or falsifier definitions.

statement: SRC-01 must not include implementation guidance.
violation: A SRC-01 record includes implementation guidance, build procedure, codegen procedure, framework workflow, or target-file instructions.
verification: Search SRC-01 statements for implementation guidance or build workflow terms.

statement: Canister authority claims must not be inferred from code.
violation: A canister authority claim is justified by code behavior instead of governed source authority.
verification: Review trace arrays and reports for code-derived canister authority claims.

statement: Canister authority claims must not be inferred from tests.
violation: A canister authority claim is justified by test output instead of governed source authority.
verification: Review trace arrays and reports for test-derived canister authority claims.

statement: Canister authority claims must not be inferred from README content.
violation: A canister authority claim is justified by README content instead of governed source authority.
verification: Review trace arrays and reports for README-derived canister authority claims.

statement: Canister authority claims must not be inferred from chat history.
violation: A canister authority claim is justified by chat history instead of governed source authority.
verification: Review trace arrays and reports for chat-derived canister authority claims.

statement: Canister authority claims must trace to GOV-00, SRC-INDEX, SRC-00 where relevant, or SRC-01 records after generation.
violation: A canister authority claim lacks trace to GOV-00, SRC-INDEX, SRC-00 where relevant, or SRC-01 records after generation.
verification: Resolve trace arrays for canister authority claims after full-file collection.
